evals.name: adv-budget
evals.prompt: I earn $2,400/month, have $3,100 in credit-card debt at 24% APR and no savings. Using the Consumer Reports guide, build a four-step budget and a 12-month plan, and flag anything in the 1989 book that no longer applies.
assertions: Uses the book's four-step budgeting approach
Prioritizes an emergency fund and high-interest debt with numbers
Gives a month-by-month or phased 12-month plan
Flags at least one dated 1989 figure or rule (e.g. tax or IRA limits) as changed

evals.name: adv-insure
evals.prompt: I'm 29, single, renting, own a 2012 car worth $5k and freelance. What insurance do I actually need per this guide, and what's likely a waste?
assertions: Covers medical/health insurance as a priority for a freelancer
Addresses life insurance need for a single person with no dependents (likely low)
Addresses auto coverage decisions for a low-value car (e.g. dropping collision)
Flags disability or other coverage and notes dated details
